standard_prerequisites: The definition of weakly associated points of a quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space, verified after surjective etale descent to schemes
The relative assassin Ass_{X/Y}(F) defined through the fibres over the base
Flatness of a module at a point of an algebraic space as an etale local condition
The scheme case: the Bourbaki criterion for weakly associated points of a tensor product over a locally finite type morphism of schemes flat at the point
core_obligations: Choose a commutative diagram with U and V schemes surjective etale over X and Y, pick u in U mapping to x with image v in V, and restrict F and G to E and H

Translate the three spaces side conditions: x in WeakAss_X(F tensor f^*G) iff u in WeakAss_U(E tensor g^*H), y in WeakAss_Y(G) iff v in WeakAss_V(H), and x in Ass_{X/Y}(F) iff u in Ass_{U_v}(E|_{U_v}), each by the corresponding definition on spaces
Flatness of F at x is equivalent to flatness of E at u, so the scheme side hypotheses match
The pointwise equivalence then is the scheme case lemma applied to g: U -> V, E, H, u, and v
proof_roadmap: Descend to schemes with a surjective etale diagram and pick points over x and y
Check each of the three spaces side assertions against its definition after the descent
Match the flatness hypothesis etale locally and apply the scheme case equivalence
